title: Find Good Days to Rob the Bank
goal: Find days surrounded by enough nonincreasing and nondecreasing security counts.
strategy: Count consecutive nonincreasing steps ending at each day and consecutive nondecreasing steps starting there. A day qualifies only if both run lengths meet time.
